title: Recognition-Refusal Misalignment in LLMs: Why Models Answer Structurally Unanswerable Questions
abstract: arXiv:2608.29109v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models often answer structurally unanswerable questions, such as computing cot(-540{\deg}) or evaluating (1).startswith("1"), instead of abstaining. We ask whether this failure reflects missing recognition or failed routing from recognition to abstention. Across instruction-tuned models from 1.7B to 70B parameters, a single linear direction in the hidden state separates answerable from structurally impossible math and code prompts, showing that models represent impossibility before generation. Yet this recognition direction is nearly orthogonal to the canonical safety-refusal direction that mediates trained harmful-content refusal. An in-domain behavior-defined invalidity-aware direction is closer to recognition, but only partially aligned with it, and remains near-orthogonal to safety refusal. translated_title: 大语言模型中的识别-拒答错位：为什么模型会回答结构上无法回答的问题
translated_abstract: 大语言模型经常回答结构上无法回答的问题，例如计算 cot(-540°) 或评估 (1).startswith("1")，而不是选择拒答。我们探究这种失败究竟是源于识别能力的缺失，还是从识别到拒答的路由失败。在参数规模从 1.7B 到 70B 的指令微调模型中，隐状态中的一个单一线性方向可以区分可回答的与结构上不可能的数学和代码提示，这表明模型在生成之前就已经表征了问题的不可能性。然而，这一识别方向与介导有害内容安全拒答的规范安全拒答方向几乎正交。一个基于领域内行为定义的无效性感知方向与识别方向更为接近，但仅部分对齐，并且仍然与安全拒答方向接近正交。在生成时沿识别方向进行引导（steering）能够以双向且剂量响应的方式改变模型的无效性感知行为。
tldr: 大语言模型在内部表征中已经能够识别问题的不可回答性，但该识别方向与安全拒答方向近乎正交，导致模型无法将“知道问题不可能”转化为实际的拒答行为。
en_tdlr: LLMs internally represent question impossibility via a linear direction before generation, but this recognition direction is nearly orthogonal to the safety-refusal direction, explaining why models answer structurally unanswerable questions instead of abstaining.
